name: claim_default_participant
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(MIN(pa.name), '') AS rep_name
FROM   xactly.xc_participant pa
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
    ON ppa.participant_id = pa.participant_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos
    ON  pos.position_id     = ppa.position_id
    AND pos.incent_st_date IS NOT NULL
WHERE  pa.is_master = 1
